name: speedrun.com API
summary: Anonymous read-only API for speedrun.com: video games, categories, leaderboards, verified runs, users and platforms.
description: The v1 REST API exposes games (with platforms, genres, developers and publishers), their categories and levels, per-category leaderboards with ranked runs, individual runs with video links and timings, users, series, guests and regions. Resources can be embedded to cut request counts. Reads need no credentials; write operations need a user API key.

auth.notes: Read endpoints are anonymous; write operations need a user API key (see the authentication doc in the source repo).

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Docs ask for a descriptive User-Agent; requests without one still returned 200 today.

rate_limit.summary: 100 requests per minute per IP (throttling doc); exceeding it returns HTTP 420.

endpoints.summary: Categories (per-game and per-level) of a game
Ranked runs for a game category

license.name: speedrun.com Terms of Service; no data license stated

agent_notes: Ids are short alphanumeric strings; find the game id with /games?name= then list its categories. Per-level categories need a /level/{id} segment in the leaderboard URL, otherwise 400. Use embed= (e.g. embed=players,category) and max=200 to save requests.
caveats: Leaderboard run records carry only user ids; embed players or fetch /users/{id} for names.
Licence terms for the data were not located; check the terms page before redistribution.
